name: zero-hidden-loss-declared-duplicates
description: Across a mixed workload (happy publishes, transient retries, schema rejections, broker failures, queue full), every submitted batch is accounted for. The no-hidden-loss invariant holds: submitted == accepted + timed_out + queue_full + dlq + declared_duplicates + unrecoverable + in_flight. All duplicates are declared (idempotent producer deduplication), never hidden.
